resources.string: Open YiZheChat to download the verified update.
Verifying this device and its security policy
The local security environment could not be initialized. Close the app and open it again.
Your local security environment is still being prepared. The app will continue automatically when ready. You can also retry.
YiZheChat will open after the version check is complete.
No valid signed security policy is available for offline use. Connect to the internet and try again.
YiZheChat could not verify the device or security policy. Check your connection and try again.
YiZheChat needs a fresh security verification before it can continue. Try again.
The security check did not finish in time. Check the network and try again.
Reconnecting automatically. The app will continue after security verification succeeds. Your account and local data are kept.
The current network cannot resolve the security service. Check the network or DNS settings.
Cannot connect to the security service
The service refused the connection or cannot be reached from this network.
The request was sent but no response arrived in time. Check the network and try again.
The network connection was interrupted during verification. Restore a stable connection and retry.
The server certificate or pinned certificate identity does not match. Startup was stopped to protect your data.
Security service rejected this device request
The service received the request but did not accept the current device state. Retry or ask an administrator to check enrollment.
Device security action is still running
A security action sent by the server has not finished yet. Try again shortly.
Security action result is awaiting delivery
The local action finished, but its result could not reach the server. Check the network and retry.
The device could not fully apply a server security action. The app will stay blocked to protect data. Retry or contact your administrator.
Android could not use this device\'s protected signing key. Restart the phone; persistent failure requires device re-enrollment.
There is no usable local signed policy and the service did not return a new one. Connect and retry.
This device has not reached the required trust state. Retry or ask an administrator to review it.
The locally stored signed policy is past its validity window. Connect to obtain a new policy.
The received policy failed signature, version, or integrity checks and was rejected.
This device\'s access ticket is no longer valid. Connect to verify device access again.
The installed app or installation identity differs from the security service record. Startup was stopped.
This APK does not contain a complete verifiable security-service configuration.
The current security state is no longer fresh and must be synchronized again.
The local and server security facts disagree and require reconciliation.
This startup verification result is no longer valid. Run the check again.
Device security passed, but no verifiable version manifest was available.
The installed package, signature, or artifact identity differs from the signed version manifest.
Startup encountered an error that has not been classified. Record the error code and contact an administrator.
The update has been verified. Continue in the Android installer.
The download is paused. Tap Resume download to continue from where it stopped.
This device needs an online check to continue. Your account and chats are retained. Access will resume automatically after verification.
The service is temporarily unavailable. Preparation will continue automatically when it recovers.
The service has limited requests. Preparation will resume after the required wait.
The current policy is being applied. Preparation will continue when it completes.
The server requires a wait of %1$d seconds. Checking will continue automatically afterwards.
Your organization does not allow automatic compatibility access. Contact your administrator to check the device policy.
The device security evidence did not pass verification. Update the app and check the system integrity, then try again.

Your previous installation still holds device authorization. Continue here to transfer it to this installation and disable access on the old one. You can then recover your chats or explicitly reset your encrypted identity.
Hold and drag the lower left handle to resize
Hold and drag the lower right handle to resize
Blocking prevents new direct messages, calls and friend requests in either direction, and ends an active direct call. Existing chat history is retained. You can unblock this person later.
You can contact this person again unless they still block you. This does not restore a removed friendship or send messages that were rejected while blocked.
